name: Webform Mattermost
description: A Webform handler for posting submission messages to Mattermost.
project_description:
Back to top 

 About 
 This module adds a handler for sending webform submissions to Mattermost .

 Back to top 

 Installation and configuration 
 
 Install the module
 Add an incoming webhook in Mattermost by following steps 1,2 and 3 of the Mattermost documentation for incoming webhooks 
 Add and configure a webform
 Add "Post to Mattermost" handler under Settings -> E-mail/Handlers
 Configure the handler 
 You can watch how to download, enable and configure the module on YouTube .
